description: All credentials reach application services and the migration runner ONLY through a controlled read-only mounted file. Never through Docker/Compose environment values, command arguments, build arguments, image layers, labels, source files or logs. A future Live deployment swaps the host secret backend for an external secret manager WITHOUT changing the application or migration contracts.

host_secret_root.files: root-owned, mode 0600 or stricter, regular files, non-symlink, single hard link, mounted read-only into the intended container only
